docs.title: Welcome to MiracleWM
docs.text:
This repository contains the configuration and documentation for my MiracleWM setup on Arch Linux.

MiracleWM is a modern, tiling Wayland compositor that provides a clean, efficient, and highly customizable desktop experience. This specific configuration is themed around a luxurious Golden & Black aesthetic.

docs.title: ✨ Features
docs.text:
• Tiling Window Management: Automatic window tiling with customizable layouts.
  • Golden Theme: Custom #EFBF04 gold accents across Waybar, Rofi, and window borders.
  • Waybar Integration: Dedicated waybar5 configuration for system monitoring and workspace management.
  • Rofi Launcher: Custom-styled application launcher and power menu.

Explore the navigation menu to find installation guides, keybindings, and theming details!

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: To get this MiracleWM setup running on your Arch Linux system, follow these steps.

docs.title: 1. Install Dependencies
docs.text: ```bash sudo pacman -S waybar rofi swaync rizen -S miracle-wm git clone https://github.com/WgpArch/miracle-wm.git ~/.config/miracle-wm cp -r ~/.config/miracle-wm-dotfiles/configs/miracle-wm/ ~/.config/miracle-wm/ cp -r ~/.config/miracle-wm-dotfiles/configs/waybar5/ ~/.config/waybar5/ cp -r ~/.config/miracle-wm-dotfiles/configs/rofi/* ~/.config/miracle-wm/rofi/ WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-98 miracle-wm

docs.title: Keybinds Reference
docs.text:
Here are the exact keybindings configured in config.yaml for this MiracleWM setup. (Note: Super refers to the Windows key).

Action Keybinding Open Terminal Super + Return Close Window Super + q Go to Workspace 1-9 Super + 1 through 9 Go to Workspace 10 Super + 0 Go to Workspace 11 Super + minus Full Screenshot Print Area Screenshot Super + Print (uses slurp & grim)

For a complete list of workspace rules and gaps, refer to ~/.config/miracle-wm/config.yaml.

docs.title: Theming & Aesthetics
docs.text: The visual identity of this setup revolves around a Golden & Black color palette for the UI elements, with custom border colors for windows.

docs.title: Color Palette
docs.text:
• Primary Gold: #EFBF04 (Used in Waybar and Rofi)
  • Background: #000000 (Solid Black)
  • Window Borders: #4c7899 (Default) and #88c0d0 (Focused)

docs.title: Startup & Components
docs.text:
• Wallpaper: Set via wbg on startup (Goldbars.jpg).
  • Notifications: Uses SwayNC (Wayland-native), not Dunst.
  • Network: nm-applet runs in the system tray.
  • Waybar: Dedicated waybar5 configuration launched directly from config.yaml.
  • Rofi: Custom config.rasi and powermenu.sh located in ~/.config/miracle-wm/rofi/.
